skipped_branches
10 IF 0 THEN ELSEvalue=1 : PRINT "BAD"
20 FOR i=2 TO 1
30 NEXTvalue=3
40 FORvalue=4
50 NEXT i
60 WHILE 0
70 WENDvalue=5
80 WHILEvalue=6
90 WEND
100 PRINT ELSEvalue;NEXTvalue;FORvalue;WENDvalue;WHILEvalue
---
 0  0  0  0  0

===
compact_print_and_identifiers
10 a=7 : printa=8
20 printa$="OK"
30 DIM printarr(2)
40 printarr(1)=9
50 PRINT"OK"
60 PRINT printa;a=8;printa$;printarr(1)
---
OK
 8  0 OK 9

===
mat_prefix_assignments
10 DIM printarr(2),readarr(2),inputarr(2),basearr(2)
20 MAT printarr=CON
30 MAT readarr=CON
40 MAT inputarr=CON
50 MAT basearr=CON
60 PRINT printarr(1);readarr(1);inputarr(1);basearr(1)
---
 1  1  1  1

===
conditional_identifier_suffix
10 XTHEN=1 : XGOTO=1
20 IF XTHEN THEN PRINT "THEN OK"
30 IF XGOTO THEN PRINT "GOTO OK"
---
THEN OK
GOTO OK

===
exit_loop_identifier_prefix
10 FOR i=1 TO 2
20 EXIT FOR
30 NEXTvalue=123
40 PRINT "BAD"
50 NEXT i
60 WHILE 1
70 EXIT WHILE
80 WENDvalue=123
90 PRINT "BAD"
100 WEND
110 PRINT NEXTvalue;WENDvalue
---
 0  0

===
mat_print_using_identifier
10 DIM USINGvalues(1)
20 MAT USINGvalues=CON
30 MAT PRINT USINGvalues
---
 1
 1

===
rem_suffix_preserves_source
10 valueREM = 123 : PRINT valueREM
20 valueREM$ = "TEXT" : PRINT valueREM$
30 DIM arrayREM(1) : arrayREM(1) = 7 : PRINT arrayREM(1)
40 PRINT valueREM;arrayREM(1)
---
 123
TEXT
 7
 123  7

===
keywords_in_literals_and_comments
10 PRINT "PRINTa=8 : REM ELSE THEN GOTO"
20 REM PRINT "BAD" : NEXT : WEND
30 DATA "IF THEN","REM",42
40 READ a$,b$,c
50 PRINT a$;":";b$;":";c ' ELSE PRINT "BAD"
---
PRINTa=8 : REM ELSE THEN GOTO
IF THEN:REM: 42

===
keyword_identifiers_in_routines
10 DEF FNdouble(printa)
20 LOCAL nextValue,remCount
30 nextValue=printa : remCount=nextValue*2
40 FNdouble=remCount
50 FNEND
60 DEF SUB PRINTresult(elseValue)
70 LOCAL dataCount
80 dataCount=elseValue : PRINT dataCount
90 SUBEND
100 CALL PRINTresult(FNdouble(7))
---
 14

===
keyword_identifiers_across_gosub
10 GOSUBvalue=1 : GOTOvalue=2 : GOSUB 100 : PRINT GOSUBvalue;GOTOvalue
20 ON 1 GOSUB 100 : PRINT "RETURNED"
30 END
100 GOSUBvalue=GOSUBvalue+1 : GOTOvalue=GOTOvalue+2
110 RETURN
---
 2  4
RETURNED

===
keyword_identifiers_in_error_handler
10 ON ERROR GOTO 100
20 PRINT 1/0 : PRINT "RESUMED"
30 PRINT resumeValue;returnValue
40 END
100 resumeValue=7 : returnValue=8
110 RESUME NEXT
---
RESUMED
 7  8

===
tab_separated_statements
10 printa	=	8
20 IF	printa=8	THEN	PRINT	printa
30 FOR	i=1	TO	2 : PRINT	i : NEXT	i
40 DATA	42
50 READ	a : PRINT	a
60 REM	PRINT "BAD"
70 PRINT"OK"
---
 8
 1
 2
 42
OK
